messages.author: 8f7ebc7f1104892e
messages.subject: grid disappears
parts:
I really like the gray grid background in the default theme. However,
whenever I give someone a graph for presentation (on a projector), the
grid disappears! On their laptop screen it looks just fine, but on
the projected screen, there is no trace of it. This seems to happen
regardless of how they got the graph image (by screenshot, from
metafile, etc.). Everything else on the graph looks fine. Does
anyone else have experience with this, and is there any way I can
convince a projector to project the lovely gray grids? -Elaine

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: grid disappears
parts:
Hi Elaine,

Typically you can fix this by adjusting the brightness of the
projected - often the default settings wash out pale greys.

Hadley
